'''Darkin''' was a [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] who worked as a researcher at the [[New Republic Medical Institute]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Darkin often gave his co-workers updates on his family's business, including his younger brother, who was an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] on Corellia, his younger sister, father, mother, and grandmother. He was also curious about his co-worker's family lives, and would often ask the other employees personal questions. The manager of medical research, [[Kirk Takill]], had to have a talk with Darkin and explain that [[Human/Legends|Humans]] generally preferred to keep their family lives private.<ref name="EGTAS" />

Darkin was upset and apologized for his behavior, explaining that few Drall left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Despite Takill telling him to keep the family talk to a minimum, it turned out that Darkin's co-workers had gotten used to listening to his daily updates. They sought Darkin out to ask about his family when he stopped updating people, leading to him regularly holding court in the lunchroom surrounded by his co-workers who wanted to listen.<ref name="EGTAS" />
